subject.title: fix(agents): decouple MCP retirement from browser cleanup

question: Should an optional opaque `OpenClawPluginToolContext.runId` become the supported public plugin contract for per-run resource ownership, or should this browser cleanup fix use a narrower browser-specific host seam?
rationale: The field is additive and documented, but it permanently expands the third-party Plugin SDK to solve a bundled browser lifecycle requirement; repository policy requires explicit maintainer-visible direction for that API boundary.

options.title: Approve the generic run contract
options.body: Keep the optional opaque `runId` field after fixing gate eviction and adding real-browser proof, allowing trusted plugins to own ephemeral per-run resources.

options.title: Keep ownership browser-specific
options.body: Remove the public context field and provide a narrower browser runtime ownership seam so the fix does not expand the general Plugin SDK.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic run contract
recommendation.body: Keep the optional opaque `runId` field after fixing gate eviction and adding real-browser proof, allowing trusted plugins to own ephemeral per-run resources.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to both one-shot subagent MCP retirement and repeated maintenance of the lifecycle controller where the API requirement originates.
